scope: Read-only diagnosis of hosted Premium cancellation availability
observedUi: Premium active; clicking Cancel subscription opens no confirmation and shows Cancellation is unavailable for this subscription.

providerCodeInference.basis: JestPlayApp maps only result.status unavailable AND result.message not_active to the unavailable UI state. Wrong SKU, missing API, guest_not_allowed, timeout and other failures map to generic error instead.

interpretation: This sandbox subscription was already ending before the current test. Premium remains entitled through period end, while the repeat cancellation attempt reports not_active. This does not establish a fresh successful cancellation or a wrong-SKU/unsupported-SDK defect.

docs.cancellation: Cancellation schedules expiry; entitlement remains active through the billing period. Official not_active guidance asks the app to refresh subscription state, which the client already does.

minimumNextAction: Use a fresh sandbox account with no active or ending Premium entitlement to verify zero-charge activation, 3,400-coin grant, cancellation confirmation and continued access through period end. Keep the current ending entitlement active and suppress duplicate checkout.
